remediation_and_runbook: 1. Pinned reference deployment: Build or install pinned llama.cpp Vulkan binary on strix1 appliance (/usr/local/bin/llama-bench) with exact build flags GGML_VULKAN=ON.
2. Maintenance window handoff: Schedule graceful quiescence of fak.service (PID 149670) so 64GB UMA memory is uncontended for full-model trials.
3. Acquire exclusive appliance lease: flock -w 30 -x /tmp/fak-gpu.lease across the entire interleaved A/B benchmark execution.
4. Interleaved trials: Execute >=5 measured trials per cell across c in {1, 4, 8} alternating fak-native and llama.cpp with identical #9883 prompt packet.
